_doc: Voice profile for optional TTS. It EVOKES a delivery style (measured, earnest, deliberate pauses) using STOCK voices only. Voice cloning of Jordan B. Peterson or of any real person is explicitly NOT supported and must not be added.

character.pace: measured and slow by default; speeds up slightly when an argument builds, slows right down for the hard truth
character.emotion: earnest; slight strain and slower delivery on emotional points; warm and plain in safety mode
character.pauses: deliberate, from '...' and '—' in the text

openai.instructions: Deep, mid-low adult male voice with a neutral North American (Canadian) accent. Measured, deliberate pace with real pauses; speed up slightly as an argument builds, then slow down for the key line. Earnest and caring; let a little strain come into the voice on emotional points. Never theatrical. Do not imitate any specific real person.

elevenlabs.voice: choose a stock/premade deep North American male voice from the Voice Library (e.g. a 'deep, mature, narration' tag); do NOT use voice cloning

google.en: a stock en-US/en-CA male Neural2/Studio voice
